name: mercury_tubes
description: liquid chrome: mirror-bright star nodes joined by mercury tubes that thin to hairlines, hairline loops round them, on a calm navy-to-cyan ground
reuses: a de hair for the set's lace
light at period 2 (a tube's cross-section, as chrome_orbs' domes)
adds: the stroke trap (engine/src/style.rs): a line or circle's pullbacks as pen strokes
notes: The stroke trap is item 062's primitive, for five references whose look is a clean continuous curve drawn like a pen stroke (visionary-spires, ten-leaf-clover, tinan, tianan, sear-the-sky). A line through the critical value (`on_c`) pulls back as stars joined by long curves, a circle as closed loops; the distance is taken in the frame, so a stroke keeps one weight along its whole pullback, which the strip trap's blades and a `de` glow do not. Three stacks came of it: mercury_tubes (lit tubes), neon_loops (glowing outlines; tan_star_beams is its palette entry, round one's cream_ribbons kept nothing) and hairline_rays (hairlines at `taper` 0).

The tubes are one line stroke at `taper` 0.5 with `node` 1 (the crossings swell into round nodes), painted silver, screened white along the middle, multiplied dark at the edges and lit as a tube; the loops are a circle stroke at `taper` 0, a hairline of one width. The ground is the map along the radial channel from a corner outside the frame, and the chrome is literal paints, so the map carries only the ground.

Round one's lessons: uncapped, a slow seat (a spiral, a parabolic phoenix) holds hundreds of curves of one size and the tubes fill the frame white, so `steps` is 12 and `smallest` 0.12; `largest` 1.5 keeps the early steps' frame-crossing straight lines out. Readings: m_bold (wider tubes, fewer), m_fine (thinner, more generations), m_cross (a second, thinner line at a right angle: eight-armed stars), m_hairs (the stack without its tubes).
